title: C++ OOP
content: C++ supports Object-Oriented Programming using classes and objects. Important OOP concepts include encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, and polymorphism, which improve code reusability and organization.

title: DBMS
content: Database Management Systems are software used to create, store, organize, manage, and retrieve data efficiently. They also help maintain data security and consistency.

title: DSA
content: Data Structures and Algorithms help organize data and solve problems efficiently. Important topics include arrays, searching, sorting, recursion, stacks, queues, and other data structures.
